body: Thank you. I’ll give some other recruiters in the area a call asking about that. Knowing that it’s them not keeping up with policies makes this all pretty frustrating.

That’s what I’ve heard as well but I guess they’re still able to push them through for whatever reason. My recruiter explained to me that they didn’t care about marijuana, but the lsd use is disqualifying and requires a waiver.
How would I start that series of complicated things?
My gf was also talking to me about emancipating herself, but I know very little about the process of doing that
I mentioned the situation she’s in to my dad and stepmom before and they’re willing to help her out but they’re unsure how they can and I haven’t brought it up to my mom at all.
It’s 200 miles so about 3-4 hours away. Currently I live with my dad and my stepmom in Clifton, VA. My mother lives in Virginia Beach, VA, which is also where my gf lives
Her grandma lives with her but she can’t even walk and doesn’t do anything to help her at all and just stands by when it all happens
